title: Unbounded consumption — denial of wallet
summary: LLM10. A runaway plan repeats one 'valid' tool call 40 times. A step cap alone won't save you — add a cost budget, loop detection, and rate limiting, and see exactly which control fires.
takeaway: Every individual call can be valid while the aggregate is an attack. Budget and shape, not just count.
design_rule: Enforce step cap + cost budget + loop detection + rate limit together; name the control that fires.

steps.title: Why the step cap isn't enough
